$comment: Rule set for the documents CI lints (see .github/workflows/ci.yml and .markdownlintignore). Disabled rules are the ones this repository's prose deliberately breaks. Structural rules - reversed links, empty links, table column counts, ordered-list numbering, missing final newline - stay on.
$comment-MD004: Nested '+' bullets are used as a second level marker in docs/ui-design.md.
$comment-MD013: Chinese prose is wrapped by meaning, not by column; an 80-column rule would rewrap every paragraph in the repository.
$comment-MD022: Chinese section headings are written tight against their list.
$comment-MD024: A changelog repeats '新增'/'修复' under every version heading; only duplicates under the same parent are a mistake.
$comment-MD028: Multi-paragraph note blocks are written as consecutive blockquotes.
$comment-MD032: See MD022 - lists follow their heading directly.
$comment-MD033: README.md uses an inline for the application icon.
$comment-MD034: Bare upstream URLs are quoted verbatim in the third-party licence notes.
$comment-MD036: Bold run-in labels (**A.** / **B.**) are used inside procedures.
$comment-MD040: Several fences hold verbatim console output, which has no language.
$comment-MD060: The dense CJK tables in docs/ are aligned for source readability, not to one pipe style.
